node.statement: Apply lem-maincb-direct-corner-envelope with c0=W.c0_cb to the nonempty set R=U union V. It gives A_R an extended L^0*epsilon-C*-algebra structure and bounds its projection, subordination, and complementarity errors by max{c0,L^0}*epsilon=L^0*epsilon. Because W.L >= L^0, weakening these defect bounds records the valid Stage-3 target tolerance epsilon_R:=W.L*epsilon and bounds those errors by W.L*epsilon.
